intent: 让同一种工具可以存在多个实例，每个实例明确绑定到自己的领域对象，而不是通过修改全局 Focus 间接决定写入目标。
use_when: 全局 Focus 只是浏览上下文而不是唯一写入目标
do_not_use_when: 工具是纯全局单例且没有对象级写入语义

interaction_contract.duplicate: creates a new ToolInstance rather than retargeting an existing pinned instance
interaction_contract.unresolved: missing pinned target remains UNRESOLVED instead of silently falling back to Focus
interaction_contract.focus: convenience context only; not canonical target ownership

visual_contract.scope_transparency: surface should expose who/where/how-many when mutation scope is non-obvious

constraints: Surface identity and domain target identity are separate.
Derived scope banners must not become a second owner of target identity or values.
